title: Seminaire de Geometrie Algebrique (SGA): English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-06-12 SGA repair017 French source-level diagram and compression repairs
description:
Public SGA working-translation record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record keeps the current reader-facing PDFs, source-scan witnesses, and compact source ZIPs for SGA translation/reconstruction work.

Status at a glance. This is a substantial working-draft and repair record, not a globally certified complete edition or critical edition. SGA5 French has additional source-level diagram repairs in repair017 for source p.92 diagram (3.3.0) and source p.107 type-1 commutative squares, plus a machine-readable SGA5 TikZ diagram index with 179 rows. This is still not an every-symbol certification. SGA5 English remains an unsynchronized carry-forward branch. SGA6 repair017/repair004 replaces compressed/non-source material in Expose VI source pp.391-397 with source-facing French transcription, including formula (2.5.2), derived morphism (2.5.3), the full Proposition 2.6 proof, the construction in 2.7, and the source proof in 2.8. The SGA6 v3 worklist still has 224 remaining rows after the page filter. SGA5/SGA6/SGA7 may still contain subtle or visible errors outside patched lanes, including diagram-arrow direction, missing-arrow, exact-symbol, and synchronization problems. SGA7-I should be read as working draft material with explicit compression/source-checking caveats unless a specific packet declares a source-checked range.

Filename warning. Older filenames containing words such as Complete, Strict, or Source-Checked are legacy package names and are not current global certification claims. Source-witness and aid ZIPs are locator/check layers, not textual authority by themselves.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Current public status follows the 2026-06-12 repair017 summary: SGA5 French has additional source-level diagram repairs and a 179-row diagram index, SGA5 English remains unsynchronized, SGA6 repair017/repair004 fixes Expose VI source pp.391-397 but leaves 224 v3 worklist rows after page filtering, and SGA7-I remains working draft material. This is not a certified critical edition; legacy file names that say Complete or Source-Checked should be overridden by this status note.
